notes: First-published SPHERE/IRDIS H-band polarimetric image (DESTINYS). Extremely clean detection of a moderately inclined disk with a 25 au inner cavity and clearly resolved back side; the fifth brightest disk of the entire NIR census, visible even in the intensity image on top of the stellar PSF. Disk features: cavity + back side (Garufi et al. 2026, Table A.5/Fig. A.1).
